documentation.content: Runbook row: Purge backlog and blocked work (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md, Current-service signal plan). Responder: on-call API responder. Log-based metric chirp_purge_aggregate (infra/monitoring/metrics/purge-job-aggregate.json) labelExtractors status crossing zero occurrences in {blocked, incomplete, timed_out, failed} over a 5-minute window; preview and complete are excluded on purpose, since a successful dry-run/preview is not successful deletion but is also not a failure. Risk: the metric's own description flags that Cloud Run Jobs stdout-to-jsonPayload promotion is unverified and must be checked against a real dedicated-identity run (c369) before this policy is activated. Follow the purge section of RECOVERY-RETENTION.md; do not rerun unbounded deletes or infer remaining=0 from unknown. Initial, review after 7 days.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND metric.type="logging.googleapis.com/user/chirp_purge_aggregate" AND (metric.labels.status="blocked" OR metric.labels.status="incomplete" OR metric.labels.status="timed_out" OR metric.labels.status="failed")
